sentence_stem: The survey was conducted in rural areas only, so
correct_completion: its findings cannot be generalised to the whole country.
full_sentence: The survey was conducted in rural areas only, so its findings cannot be generalised to the whole country.
acceptable_variants: its conclusions should not be applied to the whole country.
the results are unlikely to represent the nation as a whole.

options.text: the respondents were all over sixty years old.
options.why_wrong: The age of respondents is a different fact; 'so' needs a consequence that follows from the rural-only sampling.

options.text: the findings were widely praised by the press.
options.why_wrong: Press praise does not logically follow from a narrow sample; the sentence needs a consequence of the limitation.

options.text: its findings cannot be generalised to the whole country.
the questionnaire was translated into three languages.
options.why_wrong: Translating the questionnaire is unrelated to where the sample was taken, so it cannot be the result that 'so' introduces.

grammar_focus: Result clauses with 'so' after a passive report clause
explanation: The passive 'was conducted' gives the limitation, and 'so' introduces the logical result of that limitation. Polish speakers often add a clause about an unrelated fact after 'so' because Polish allows looser links between the two parts; in English the result must follow directly from the first clause.
translation: Badanie przeprowadzono wyłącznie na obszarach wiejskich, więc jego wyników nie można uogólnić na cały kraj.
